question: Gurpurab is one of the holiest festivals of Sikhism, celebrated to commemorate the birth anniversary of:
solution:
The correct answer is **Guru Nanak Dev.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points**__

__
 
• **Guru Nanak** was an **Indian spiritual leader** who founded **Sikhism,** a **monotheistic religion **with **Hindu and Muslim roots**. He was born in **Rai Bhoi di Talvandi **(now Nankana Sahib, Pakistan), close to **Lahore**, and passed away at **Kartarpur, Punjab, in 1539.**
 
• As both their founder and the supreme master of **Punjabi **devotional singing, he maintains a particular place in the **hearts of modern Sikhs.**
 
• After some time, he settled in the **Punjabi village of Kartarpur**, where he amassed a sizable following and became known as the **first Guru of the Sikhs.**
 
• The **Janam-sakhis** are collections of stories about his life that were gathered after his passing. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Points**__

**Guru Amar Das**

 
• **Guru Amar Das (1522–1574)**, the** third Sikh Guru, **was granted this name at the advanced age of 73. He was born in **Khadur, India, in 1479**, and passed away in **Goindwal in 1574.**
 
• He is well known for establishing administrative districts in **Punjab** and lending assistance to** Sikh missionary initiatives.**

**Guru Tegh Bahadur**

 
• **Guru Tegh Bahadur,** the second** Sikh martyr **and **ninth Sikh Guru (1664–1775), **was born in **Amritsar, Punjab, India,** on November 11, 1621, and died there on November 11, 1675.
 
• He was also the **10th Guru's father, Gobind Singh.**

**Guru Gobind Singh ** 

 
• **The Khalsa (Punjabi: "the Pure," the Sikhs' military brotherhood) was established by Guru Gobind Singh**, sometimes referred to as **Gobind Ri, **the tenth and final personal **Sikh Guru (1675–1708)**. He was born in India's Patna, Bihar, in 1666, and passed away on October 7, 1708, in Nanded, Maharashtra.
